description:
Archives a Client who has left: their open Chases become skipped and their links stop working; they stop counting towards the plan limit. confirm:false (default) shows what would change. unarchive:true brings them back.
Use this when: a Client leaves the practice or comes back.

client.description: Client name, email or your own reference

confirm.description: false (default) = dry run: shows what would happen, changes nothing. true = do it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

name: archive_client
title: Archive or unarchive a Client
